newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Nafta picks Dresdner privatisation adviser.
newsitem.headline: Polish Nafta picks Dresdner privatisation adviser.

text.p: Polish oil holding company Nafta Polska SA has picked a consortium led by Dresdner Kleinwort Benson and Business Management & Finance to advise it on the privatisation of two groups of refineries it owns, Nafta said on Wednesday.

The adviser will be responsible for preparing an analysis of the refineries' structure and for working out a privatisation strategy in cooperation with the firm's board, which will be then approved by the cabinet.
"(The documents) will be ready and approved in two to three months' time," Nafta Polska board member Marek Foltynowicz told reporters, adding that a tender would follow.
Nafta Polska board president Jerzy Kaminski said the management would like to see the company traded by the end of 1997. "Everything depends on the adviser," he said.
Kaminski hinted that after the initial sale of 20 to 30 percent of the refineries' stake, investors would be eligible for additional shares on the implementation of investment programmes.
"Costs (of the adviser's services) will be covered by the refineries and the state-owned fuel distribution chain CPN," Kaminski said.
